name: Full frontend E2E tests

# The full matrix against stage: every pair, token and order type, including
# the tests tagged @full that PR runs leave out, and the claim tests. PR runs
# (frontend-e2e-tests.yml) check one representative case per path.
#
# It runs on the stage -> master release PR, against the stage build being
# released, so every release gets the full matrix; `release-gate` is the check
# to require on master. It can also be run by hand from the Actions tab.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    branches:
      - master

# One run per release PR (a newer push to stage replaces it); manual runs
# queue behind each other.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 'manual' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Waits until the stage deployment of the commit under test (the release
  # PR's head, or the commit a manual run started on) is live, so the tests
  # run against it rather than the previous build. Other PRs into master
  # (hotfix branches, forks) and draft release PRs skip the suites; the
  # suites spend real funds.
  stage-deploy:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || (github.head_ref == 'stage' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false && github.event.pull_request.draft == false)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 50
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out deployment lookup
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
      - name: Wait for the stage deployment
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          EVENT: push
        run: bash .github/scripts/wait-cf-deployment.sh

  wallet-tests:
    needs: stage-deploy
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: macos-26
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            /package.json
            /yarn.lock
            /.yarnrc.yml
            /.yarn-4.18.1.cjs
            /packages/*/package.json
            /packages/web/etc/
            /packages/e2e/
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          package-manager-cache: false
          node-version: 24.x
      - name: Install Playwright
        run: yarn workspaces focus app-osmosis-e2e && npx playwright install chromium
      - name: Cancel leftover open orders
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_PRIVATE_KEY_PREVIEW }}
          ACCOUNT_LABEL: "E2E Test Account (pre-test cleanup)"
          # The wallet is shared with PR runs; leave their in-flight orders alone.
          MIN_ORDER_AGE_MINUTES: "20"
        run: npx tsx packages/e2e/scripts/cancel-all-orders.ts
      - name: Run wallet tests
        working-directory: packages/e2e
        env:
          BASE_URL: https://stage.osmosis.zone
          PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.E2E_PRIVATE_KEY_PREVIEW }}
          E2E_FULL: "true"
        run: npx playwright test swap.osmo.wallet swap.usdc.wallet trade.wallet claim portfolio transactions
      - name: Upload test results
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-arti

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
